hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap implements a custom AMM curve as a Uniswap v4 hook backed by Euler Finance vaults. Swaps are handled entirely in beforeSwap via a BeforeSwapDelta — depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults — while verifying a custom bonding curve invariant. Standard concentrated liquidity (addLiquidity, donate) is intentionally blocked.
